blocking_findings.title: Keep controller provenance entries as flat artifact descriptors
blocking_findings.body: [INFERENCE: static consumer trace; binder and stage guards were not executed.] C24 inserts grouped dictionaries under provenance for actual_C23_rejected_original_control_opinion, actual_Main_consumer_before_and_after, and actual_final_F66_SOURCE3. bind_selected_source.py:113–114 passes every provenance value directly to successor_support.matched(), which asserts exactly the four keys path/sha256/bytes/mode at successor_support.py:67–70. The first new value instead has actual_model/review keys, so even with a genuine positive seven-file review the normal binder fails before emitting the postbound six. portable_goal.check_profile() repeats the same flat-descriptor check at lines 84–85; preparation and authorization reach it through check_observation(), so the mismatch also blocks fresh controller stage validation. Flatten the leaf receipts into individually named four-field provenance entries, or move grouped descriptive metadata outside provenance, preserving the existing goal-observation keys and descriptor validation.
